changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER VIEW [reporting].[Workflows] AS select T.Name as WorkflowTypeName, T.Description as WorkflowTypeDescription, I.ID as ItemID, I.Active, I.StartedBy, I.StartedOn, I.CompletedBy, I.CompletedOn, I.Object, I.ObjectID, V.Version from workflow.Item I inner join workflow.[Version] V on V.ID = I.VersionID inner join workflow.Type T on T.ID = V.TypeID
